title: The Rich Man's Road
logline: A wealthy corporation has bought exclusive rights to a critical hyper-lane, forcing local traders to brave a deadly nebula instead, until a retired legend decides to break the blockade.

roles.description: An old blockade runner who can't stand seeing corporations own the stars.
Smug, heavily guarded, and legally untouchable.
A massive, heavily armed warp-gate facility.
An incredibly fast, illegally modified courier vessel.
The shareholders who technically own the space.
A hidden dock where the runner is prepped.
An armed cutter defending the gate.

public_situation: The {role:corporate_board} has established a private {role:toll_gate}, forcing independent pilots to pay exorbitant fees or fly blindly through the dangerous nebula.
private_truth: The corporation doesn't actually have the legal charter for the gate; they just built it and dared anyone to stop them.

beats.public_change: The retired legend publicly announces their intention to fly through the gate without paying.

missions.reason: The legend hires the pilot to map the gate's automated targeting sensors.
missions.private_fact: The scan will flag the pilot as a hostile target to the gate.

beats.public_change: The corporation deploys heavy defense platforms to block the lane completely.

missions.reason: The legend needs the pilot to deliver a highly illegal jamming spike to their runner ship before the run.
missions.private_fact: The spike will short out the gate's payment processors entirely.

missions.reason: The legend hires the pilot to take out the gate's automated toll buoy, which would otherwise flag the run.
missions.private_fact: The buoy is the gate's only rear-facing sensor; without it the gate is half blind.

beats.public_change: The legend's ship approaches the gate at maximum velocity.

missions.reason: The legend pays the pilot to attack the tollkeeper's patrol ship to break the blockade.
missions.private_fact: The patrol ship hails the pilot mid-fight, offering a cut of the tolls to turn on the legend.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps blind the gate.
resolutions.summary: The legend flies through, the payment systems crash, and the lane is effectively opened to the public. The corporation is humiliated.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blasted open a corporate toll gate, freeing up a hyper-lane for independent traders.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the tollkeeper's offer.
resolutions.summary: The legend is shot down. The corporation secures absolute control over the lane, and the pilot becomes their favored pet.
The legend tries to run the gate alone and is obliterated by automated defenses. The toll remains.

loose_threads.detail: A deep scan of the gate's broadcast registry shows it is operating under a charter granted by a government that fell a decade ago.
The tollkeeper gloats that all gate revenue is being funneled directly into building a private mercenary fleet.

radio_hooks: {role:corporate_board} reports record profits from new 'Transit Efficiency Fee'.
Independent pilots gather at the nebula's edge, afraid to jump.

voice_direction.corporate_tollkeeper: Smug, bureaucratic, uses corporate buzzwords to threaten people.
